part.text:
Report on the pattern elsewhere in `packages/react`:

**Found 3 render-inline `composeRefs(...)` call sites (the same unstable-identity pattern):**

| File | Line | Ref members | Same bug? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu.tsx` `MenuSubTrigger` | 1056 | `forwardedRef` + `subContext.onTriggerChange` (= `setTrigger` state setter) | **Yes** — reproduced (see below) |
| `dropdown-menu.tsx` `DropdownMenuTrigger` | 116 | `forwardedRef` + `context.triggerRef` (ref object) | **Yes** — reproduced |
| `navigation-menu.tsx` `NavigationMenuViewport` | 1081 | `ref` (item) + `(node) => { if (isActive && node) setContent(node); }` | **No** — `setContent` is guarded by `isActive && node` and React bails when the node is unchanged, so it can't loop. Also it's inside a `.map()`, so `useComposedRefs` can't be hoisted without a larger refactor. |

## What I fixed (the two "same bug" sites)

Both `menu.tsx` and `dropdown-menu.tsx` hoisted the inline `composeRefs(...)` into `useComposedRefs(...)`, which memoizes the composed ref so its identity is stable across renders (same principle as the Slot fix). The member refs are the same — behavior preserved; only the identity is stabilized.

## Verification

- Wrote `menu-ref-stability.test.tsx` and `dropdown-menu-ref-stability.test.tsx`; both failed with `Maximum update depth exceeded` on the original code and pass after the fix (confirmed each by temporarily reverting).
- `pnpm vitest run packages/react/slot packages/react/menu packages/react/dropdown-menu` → 4 files / 36 tests pass.
- `oxlint` and `tsc --noEmit` clean for all three packages.
- Added changesets for `@radix-ui/react-menu` and `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu` (patch), alongside the existing slot one.

Files changed: `packages/react/menu/src/menu.tsx`, `packages/react/dropdown-menu/src/dropdown-menu.tsx`, plus the two new regression test files and two changesets. `navigation-menu` left untouched (not the same bug).
